text: maria-l: Heads-up — I noticed a fragment/anchor mismatch between the English serving-routing guide and the Japanese translation. The EN link uses #policy-choices but the JA page has #policyChoices, so in-product links are landing higher-up and losing the section. Anyone owns the ja/guides/serving-routing page? jamal: Can you paste the exact links so I can reproduce quickly? maria-l: Sure — en: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/serving-routing#policy-choices ja: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/ja/guides/serving-routing#policyChoices docs-bot: linkcheck: detected fragment mismatch on /ja/guides/serving-routing (referrer: /guides/serving-routing). First seen 2025-11-20. olivia: This came in as part of the ja backport last quarter, I think a heading rename slipped through. Localization team normally owns the ja content, but small anchor fixes are fine for docs folks to patch. @yuki any preference? yuki: I can own the localization side — will coordinate. Prefer we avoid renaming the en anchor if other links reference it. For a quick fix: add an alias anchor in the ja page to match the en fragment. sam: I can open a tiny PR to add the anchor alias and a smoke curl test. No objections? :+1: jamal: +1 from me. Also suggest adding a one-line smoke check in the docs CI for that page so fragile fragment links get caught. sam: What sed/snippet should I run locally before the PR? maria-l: Example quick hack (works for the single file; adjust paths in your PR): ```bash # insert a hidden HTML anchor before the Policy heading in ja file sed -n '1,200p' ja/guides/serving-routing.md | awk '/^#+ Policy/{print ""}1' > tmp.md && mv tmp.md ja/guides/serving-routing.md ``` # curl smoke check to validate fragment lands (status 200 + final URL): ```bash curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}" "https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/ja/guides/serving-routing#policy-choices" ``` yuki: LGTM. I'll add localization reviewer label. Sam — please @mention me in the PR and cc @docs-infra if you modify frontmatter or CI. sam: On it. Will aim for a one-line HTML anchor plus a tiny test in the docs smoke suite. Assigning to myself and requesting reviewers yuki, olivia. maria-l: Thanks everyone. I'll log a short KB note about this translation/heading drift so we can catch similar cases during backports :memo:
